questions.q: An enclosed smoking room should be kept at:
questions.n: Air flows in, not out, so smoke stays contained.

questions.q: A cassette air conditioner is installed:
questions.n: Cassettes sit flush in the ceiling and blow four ways.

questions.q: A kitchen fire suppression system (KFSS) over the cooking line is expected in a:
questions.n: Commercial cooking hoods need wet-chemical suppression.

questions.q: Which split-system component sits outside the building?
questions.n: The condensing unit rejects heat outdoors.

questions.q: A clean-agent gas that leaves no residue, used in server rooms, is:
questions.n: FM-200 (HFC-227ea) replaced Halon in many rooms.

questions.q: Which statement about elevators is correct?
o: The counterweight equals twice the car weight
The governor trips the safeties when the car overspeeds
Buffers stop the car in normal service
questions.n: The counterweight is about car weight plus 40–50% of rated load; buffers are emergency only.

questions.q: The serrated plate at an escalator landing that steps slide under, guarding against trapping, is the:
questions.n: Comb teeth mesh with the step cleats.

questions.q: The most effective way to control indoor air quality is:
o: Air cleaning and filtration with ventilation
questions.n: Remove contaminants, don't mask them.

questions.q: The air outlet with a built-in damper to adjust volume is a:
questions.n: A register is a grille with a damper.

questions.q: A "universal" split-type air conditioner can be mounted:
o: On a wall, the floor or the ceiling
questions.n: Universal (convertible) units mount several ways.

questions.q: Standard maximum incline of an escalator:
questions.n: 30° is standard (35° allowed for short rises).

questions.q: The space between the structural slab and a suspended ceiling is the:
questions.n: Plenums carry ducts and services.

questions.q: A single hoistway may hold at most how many elevators?
questions.n: Codes cap a common hoistway at four cars.

questions.q: The grooved pulleys that carry the ropes in a traction elevator are:
questions.n: The drive sheave grips the ropes by traction.

questions.q: Ducts from rooftop units pass through a fire-rated roof assembly. The design must include:
questions.n: Dampers keep the rated assembly intact.

questions.q: In a sprinkler system, the small pump that tops up pressure when no heads are flowing is the ______; the big pump that starts when heads open is the ______.
questions.n: The jockey pump makes up leakage; the fire pump supplies discharge.

questions.q: Fire spread across a ceiling plenum is limited by:
o: Fire-rated barriers or draftstops dividing the plenum
questions.n: The plenum must be compartmentalized.

questions.q: A small museum with sensitive artifacts should be protected by a:
questions.n: Pipes stay dry until detection, so there's less risk of accidental water damage.

questions.q: Two ceiling cassette indoor units need how many hanger rods in total?
questions.n: Each cassette hangs from 4 rods.

questions.q: Which is NOT a firestop material?
questions.n: Polyethylene burns and melts.

questions.q: VESDA is a very early warning:
questions.n: It samples air through pipes to catch smoke early.

questions.q: A downward air jet across a doorway that keeps conditioned air in and insects out is an:
questions.n: Air curtains seal an opening without a door.

questions.q: The central "brain" of a fire alarm system is the:
questions.n: All initiating and notification devices report to the FACU.

questions.q: Which is a notification device, NOT an initiating device?
questions.n: Strobes and horns notify; detectors and pull stations initiate.

questions.q: A pump that sits underwater inside the tank or well is a:
questions.n: Submersible units are sealed to run immersed.

questions.q: To raise weak supply pressure for upper floors, install a:
questions.n: Booster sets increase line pressure.

questions.q: In a trussed roof space, fire spread is limited by installing:
questions.n: Draftstops divide the attic into compartments.

questions.q: Air conditioner noise is stated in:
questions.n: A-weighted decibels approximate human hearing.

questions.q: Mold and mildew in a room are best prevented with a:
questions.n: Lower humidity starves mold growth.

questions.q: Which room would you flag to the mechanical engineer for extra exhaust?
questions.n: Heat, smoke and grease must be exhausted.

questions.q: An escalator truss is usually built in how many sections?
questions.n: Upper, middle and lower sections.

questions.q: In an elevator, the flexible cable carrying power and signals between the car and the controller is the:
questions.n: It hangs from the car and moves with it.

questions.q: Above an open wood-slat ceiling hung from the slab, the sprinklers should be:
questions.n: The spray must reach through the open grid.

questions.q: Fire-resistance ratings are stated in:
questions.n: Ratings run 1, 2, 3, 4 hours.

questions.q: The gaps around pipes and ducts passing through rated walls and floors must be:
questions.n: Firestop systems restore the barrier's rating.

questions.q: In a convenience store, the AC condensing unit is placed:
questions.n: It must reject heat to outdoor air.

questions.q: Least appropriate place for a dry standpipe outlet:
questions.n: Firefighters connect at stairs and protected routes.

questions.q: Which is ACTIVE fire protection?
questions.n: Active systems operate on detection; passive ones resist fire by construction.

questions.q: Spray-applied fireproofing is mostly for:
questions.n: Steel loses strength fast in fire, so it's the member that gets sprayed.

questions.q: Keep storage at least this far below sprinkler deflectors:
questions.n: An 18-inch clearance lets the spray pattern develop.

questions.q: Water collecting in a basement pit is pumped out by a:
questions.n: Sump pumps empty drainage pits.
